# Extend the Game 🚀

#### Course: Brick Breaker with JavaScript

## Extend the Game 🚀

Your Brick Breaker is complete. It is also a solid foundation.

All of the features below fit inside the architecture you already have without touching the core game loop.

Multiple Levels

After all bricks are cleared, rebuild the grid instead of ending:

```javascriptDOM
// in checkBrickCollisions(), replace the win transition:

if (this.bricks.every(b => !b.isAlive)) {
  this.level++;
  this.buildBricks();
  this.resetRound();
}
```

The hud-level span is already in your HTML waiting to be used.

Speed Increase per Level

Pass the level into the launch speed so each round gets slightly faster:

```javascriptDOM
launch(level = 1) {
  const speed = BALL_BASE_SPEED + (level - 1) * 0.4;

  this.ballSpeedX = speed * Math.sin(angle);
  this.ballSpeedY = -speed * Math.cos(angle);
}
```

Multi-Hit Bricks

Give Brick a hits property. Change the color when partially damaged:

```javascriptDOM
constructor(col, row) {
  ...
  this.hits = row < 2 ? 2 : 1;  // top two rows take two hits
}
```

In checkBrickCollisions(), decrement instead of immediately killing:

```javascriptDOM
brick.hits--;
if (brick.hits <= 0) brick.isAlive = false;
```

Power-Ups

When a brick is destroyed, randomly drop a falling entity. If the paddle catches it, trigger an effect. Wider paddle, extra life, slow motion, or multi-ball. All of these are just new entities following the same pattern you already know.
